title: offline-bundle: vendor runtime deps and add kube-distro support for air-gapped installs
author: Aisha Kumar
description:
Motivation: Customers deploying Redwood Private in air-gapped/on-prem environments require a single reproducible offline bundle that includes vendored container images, Helm charts, CRD artifacts and distro-specific runtime manifests. Previous installer iterations relied on customers mirroring public registries or running an external proxy, which is error-prone for regulated environments. This PR implements an end-to-end offline bundle generation workflow, vendorizes key runtime dependencies, and introduces config overlays for multiple kube distros (kubeadm, RKE2, k0s) so installs are resilient to distro-specific networking and CRI differences.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new CLI command: "installer bundle create-offline --output <dir> --kube-distro <distro> --images-list <file>". This command downloads and packs: container images (tarred), Helm chart tgz, vendor/operator manifests, CRDs, and a distro overlay. The command supports a --verify-checksum mode to produce SHA256 manifest.
- Vendors runtime dependencies into /bundles/<version>/vendor: nginx-ingress (forked minimal manifest), cert-manager v1.12.0, redis-operator, and the redwood-runtime Helm chart tarball. All vendored artifacts are stored with provenance files (SOURCE, CHECKSUM).
- Helm chart changes: chart/templates now include a distro-overlay conditional path so values can toggle kube-distro specific defaults (service type, hostNetwork/hostPort handling, init container CRI adjustments). Added a new values.kubeDistro map with supported keys: kubeadm, rke2, k0s.
- Installer manifests: Introduces a small distro runtime shim that patches ServiceAccount annotations and PodSecurityPolicy alternatives for distros that lack PSP (k0s).
- Terraform module updates: terraform/modules/private-installer now exposes bundle_source (local archive path) and pre-seeded_registry config used by on-prem mirror bootstrap. Added a helper script terraform/bootstrap-mirror.sh to load images into a registry.
- Upgrade/rollback: bundle metadata contains a bundle.manifest.json (packaged as string in the bundle) that the installer uses to detect bundle mismatch and offer an automated just-in-time partial rollback of Helm release values when upgrading between vendored runtime sets.

Testing and validation:
- Added unit tests for the CLI arg parsing and checksum verification.
- Integration test harness (perf-lab simulated air-gapped cluster) exercised bundle create-offline -> bootstrap-mirror -> installer apply on kubeadm and k0s. Test logs attached in CI artifact.
- Manual verification run with a customer-provided RKE2 lab cluster uncovered and fixed a DNS kube-dns readiness race (handled via a preflight wait step and configurable timeout).

Backward compatibility and migration notes:
- The installer still supports the existing online install flow; offline bundle support is opt-in and gated behind --bundle.
- Existing Terraform deployments can set bundle_source to null to keep previous behavior.

Security and compliance:
- All vendored images are signed using our internal Cosign key and signatures are included in /vendor/signatures. The CLI emits a human-readable provenance log for audit.
- No runtime secrets are introduced into the bundle. KMS/HSM integrations remain unchanged.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Automate periodic vendor refresh job to rotate bundled third-party components.
- Add RKE2-specific systemd tweak presets and more exhaustive distro conformance tests.

References: Linear ENG-2319, ENG-2494 (upgrade tooling), customer ticket SUP-9042 (air-gapped install requests).

review_comments: Diego Morales (reviewer): Nice work. A few asks: please split the big vendor tarball creation into a streamable path (memory bounds) and add a health-check for the mirror bootstrap script.
Aisha Kumar (author): Thanks — split the tar streaming logic into streamTarWriter() and added a --buffer-size flag. mirror bootstrap now retries with exponential backoff and reports per-image errors.
Lin Chen (reviewer): Helm template change looks good but we should avoid introducing hostNetwork by default. Please ensure kubeDistro defaults are conservative.
Aisha Kumar (author): Updated values.yaml to set hostNetwork: false for all distros by default and added an explicit example in docs for when hostNetwork is required.
QA (reviewer): Integration tests failed on RKE2 due to kube-dns readiness. Reproduced locally. Suggested adding a preflight wait for DNS with configurable timeout.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added preflight wait step and a new flag --preflight-timeout with default 5m; re-ran integration tests and they pass in CI artifacts.

release_notes: Add offline bundle generation and vendoring for on-prem/air-gapped installs. Supports kubeadm, RKE2 and k0s overlays. Introduces a Terraform hook for pre-seeding registries and a CLI verifier for bundle provenance.
merge_outcome: Merged into main via squash on 2026-02-23 by release-bot. CI green except known flaky RKE2 job which is tracked in ENG-2560. Backported docs patch to release/2026.02 via follow-up PR.
